commands.name: workflow_new
commands.description: Starts a new, empty workflow window: File > New, then Workflow in Automator's type chooser.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "ui": Automator's scripting didn't answer in testing.

commands.precondition: The program has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events.
commands.postcondition: An empty workflow window is in front.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a named element never appeared, or the change wasn't seen in time

errors.name: StateBlocked
errors.when: the workflow has a dialog open, or another app came to the front; nothing is changed

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.when: mode is "background": Automator's scripting didn't answer in testing

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 with Automator 2.10 only, so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.
It depends on English names and was tested only in English.
Only the Workflow type was tested; Quick Action, Application and the other types weren't.

commands.name: workflow_add_action
commands.description: Adds a library action by its exact name to the end of the workflow in front.

args.name: name
args.meaning: The action's exact name in Automator's library, such as Scale Images.

args.name: copy_first
args.meaning: For actions that change files, whether to accept Automator's offer to add Copy Finder Items first.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "ui": Automator's scripting didn't answer in testing.

example_requests: Add Scale Images to the workflow
Put a Change Type of Images step in
commands.precondition: The program has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events.
commands.postcondition: The workflow ends with the action (and Copy Finder Items before it if copy_first was accepted).

errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a named element never appeared, or the change wasn't seen in time

errors.name: StateBlocked
errors.when: the workflow has a dialog open, or another app came to the front; nothing is changed

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: no action has that name, or no workflow window is in front

errors.name: NotSupported

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 with Automator 2.10 only, so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.

The action's options and input files aren't set; they keep Automator's defaults.

commands.name: workflow_save
commands.description: Saves the workflow in front as a new .workflow file (File > Save…).

args.name: path
args.meaning: A new absolute path (or starting with ~) ending in .workflow.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "ui": Automator's scripting didn't answer in testing.

example_requests: Save this workflow to my Documents
commands.precondition: The program has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events.
commands.postcondition: The .workflow file holds the workflow's actions.
